body:
The trick 'Rise from the charmer basket' (you OK'd it) needs an open basket; the top was closed.
Now (book v161): open top with a dark inside, woven bands and a rim; the lid lies beside it, the flute in front.
Pick in Model Compare → Snake flute and basket (🔔).
short: Check: the snake can rise out of it
title: Snake charmer basket: open top
